title: Week 2 Tutorials — Premiere Pro: Multi-Camera Interview Editing
description: This tutorial set builds on Week 1 by introducing workflows specific to interview-based and multi-camera editing. Students will learn how to import footage directly from a camera (via SD card or USB), organize clips from multiple cameras, synchronize audio and video using clap sync, and sequence three camera angles within the timeline. The tutorials also cover basic cropping and trimming for pacing, as well as an introduction to multi-camera editing techniques suitable for documentary interviews.

children.title: Importing from camera (USB / SD)
children.description: If you want to edit faster, stop using the razer tool and start using short cuts. Learn how to setup an use shortcuts for basic editing.

children.title: How to sync multiple clips in premiere - Fast editor pro tip
children.description: Learn how to sync multiple clips in premiere by audio. The method you should be using is presented in the first 30 seconds. The rest of the video is useful if you have multiple different shots of the same or several interviews.

children.title: How to Edit 2 Camera Interviews Like a Pro (Advance)
children.description: Here's how to edit multi-camera interviews in Adobe Premiere, and incorporate b-roll, graphics, and music. Knowing how to sync and create sequences from 2 cameras (or more) is a crucial skill for professional assistant editors and editors.

children.title: Quick Tips for Editing Interviews (Advance)
children.description: Check for a few strategies on editing interview footage.
